description: Explainable real-time rule-based matching engine combining verified FoodBridge MongoDB NGOs and OpenStreetMap external organizations.

factors.name: distance
factors.calculation: Haversine formula straight-line distance in kilometers
factors.availabilityRule: Available when both donor and NGO coordinates exist and are within valid bounds (-90 to 90 lat, -180 to 180 lng)
factors.normalizationRule: Max score (1.0) for distance <= 1km, linear decay down to 0.0 at 25km

factors.name: categoryMatch
factors.calculation: Exact or normalized match between donation category and NGO historical request categories
factors.availabilityRule: Available when donation category is defined
factors.normalizationRule: 1.0 for direct category match, 0.5 for general match, 0.0 for no match

factors.name: expiryUrgency
factors.calculation: Calculates remaining hours until donation expiry (CRITICAL < 6h, URGENT < 24h, NORMAL >= 24h)
factors.availabilityRule: Available when valid expiry timestamp exists
factors.normalizationRule: Higher urgency favors closer NGOs to minimize transportation time

factors.name: historicalDemand
factors.calculation: Count of historical FoodRequest records created by NGO for the specific food category
factors.availabilityRule: Available for MongoDB NGOs with historical request records; marked unavailable for OSM entries
factors.normalizationRule: Score scales with historical category request volume

factors.name: currentWorkload
factors.calculation: Count of currently active/pending FoodRequest records for the NGO
factors.availabilityRule: Available for MongoDB NGOs; marked unavailable if capacity is not stored
factors.normalizationRule: Slight penalty for high active pending workload to prevent overloading

factors.name: verificationStatus
factors.calculation: Verification check against MongoDB User record
factors.availabilityRule: Available for MongoDB NGOs (1.0); marked EXTERNAL (0.5) for OSM entries
factors.normalizationRule: 1.0 for verified MongoDB partners, 0.5 for external OSM facilities

dynamicNormalization: If any factor data is unavailable, the factor is placed in factorsUnavailable and the final Match Score is normalized strictly over the sum of weights of available factors.
